title: Scientists find traces of underground dwellers in mountains
summary: Russian Republic tells of Scientists find traces of underground dwellers in mountains, about unspecified at Caucasus, India, Tibet, Altai, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And I know some scientists who study caves and rocks. When I was in the Caucasus, when I was in India, in Tibet, in the Alaii, they found traces there,

plain: An official described as the president of a republic within Russia tells Jesse Michels that he knows scientists who study caves and rocks. He says that in the Caucasus mountains, in India, in Tibet and in the Altai mountains of Central Asia, they found traces of beings living underground, which would suggest hidden peoples dwelling inside the mountains.
